line.hanzi: 你好。
line.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo.
line.en: Hello.

line.hanzi: 是我。是你。
line.pinyin: Shì wǒ. Shì nǐ.
line.en: It is me. It is you.

line.hanzi: 这。那。
line.pinyin: Zhè. Nà.
line.en: This one. That one.

line.hanzi: 一。二。
line.pinyin: Yī. Èr.
line.en: One. Two.

line.hanzi: 三。四。
line.pinyin: Sān. Sì.
line.en: Three. Four.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 你好。我工作，你工作？
line.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Wǒ gōngzuò, nǐ gōngzuò?
line.en: Hello. I work — will you?

line.hanzi: 一、二、三、四。这是杯子，那是碗。
line.pinyin: Yī, èr, sān, sì. Zhè shì bēizi, nà shì wǎn.
line.en: One, two, three, four. This is a cup; that is a bowl.

line.hanzi: 那是碗。
line.pinyin: Nà shì wǎn.
line.en: That is a bowl.

line.hanzi: 这是杯子，那是碗。杯子，{cup_count}个？
line.pinyin: Zhè shì bēizi, nà shì wǎn. Bēizi, {cup_count} ge?
line.en: These are cups, those bowls. Cups — {cup_count}?

line.hanzi: 杯子几个？你做。
line.pinyin: Bēizi jǐ ge? Nǐ zuò.
line.en: How many cups? You do them.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 你好。你工作，我工作。这是杯子，请。
line.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Nǐ gōngzuò, wǒ gōngzuò. Zhè shì bēizi, qǐng.
line.en: Hello. You work, I work. Here are the cups, please.

line.hanzi: 这是水，那是茶。茶，请。
line.pinyin: Zhè shì shuǐ, nà shì chá. Chá, qǐng.
line.en: This is water, that is tea. Tea, please.

line.hanzi: 这是水，你喝水。
line.pinyin: Zhè shì shuǐ, nǐ hē shuǐ.
line.en: This is water. You drink water.

line.hanzi: {cup_count}个杯子，请。你做。
line.pinyin: {cup_count} ge bēizi, qǐng. Nǐ zuò.
line.en: {cup_count} cups, please. You do them.

line.hanzi: 杯子六个，碗八个。杯子几个？
line.pinyin: Bēizi liù ge, wǎn bā ge. Bēizi jǐ ge?
line.en: Six cups, eight bowls. How many cups?

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 你好。你工作，我工作。米饭，有？
line.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Nǐ gōngzuò, wǒ gōngzuò. Mǐfàn, yǒu?
line.en: Hello. You work, I work. Rice — any?

line.hanzi: 这是杯子，那是碗。菜，有？
line.pinyin: Zhè shì bēizi, nà shì wǎn. Cài, yǒu?
line.en: These are cups, those are bowls. Dishes — any?

line.hanzi: 一、二、三、四。水，有。茶，没有。
line.pinyin: Yī, èr, sān, sì. Shuǐ, yǒu. Chá, méiyǒu.
line.en: One, two, three, four. Water: yes. Tea: none.

line.hanzi: 水，我喝。茶，我不喝。
line.pinyin: Shuǐ, wǒ hē. Chá, wǒ bù hē.
line.en: Water I drink. Tea I don't.

line.hanzi: 有米饭，有菜。请吃米饭。你做。
line.pinyin: Yǒu mǐfàn, yǒu cài. Qǐng chī mǐfàn. Nǐ zuò.
line.en: There's rice, there's dishes. Please eat the rice. You do it.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 请喝茶。你能工作。这个工作，我会做。
line.pinyin: Qǐng hē chá. Nǐ néng gōngzuò. Zhè ge gōngzuò, wǒ huì zuò.
line.en: Please, have some tea. You can work. This job, I know how to do.

line.hanzi: 我想喝茶，我喜欢茶。
line.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē chá, wǒ xǐhuan chá.
line.en: I want tea; I like tea.

line.hanzi: 有米饭，没有菜。茶很好，水不太好。
line.pinyin: Yǒu mǐfàn, méiyǒu cài. Chá hěn hǎo, shuǐ bú tài hǎo.
line.en: There's rice, no dishes. The tea is very good; the water not so good.

line.hanzi: 我吃米饭，我会做菜。你能做？
line.pinyin: Wǒ chī mǐfàn, wǒ huì zuò cài. Nǐ néng zuò?
line.en: I eat rice, and I can cook dishes. Can you?

line.hanzi: 碗没有八个，杯子有六个。
line.pinyin: Wǎn méiyǒu bā ge, bēizi yǒu liù ge.
line.en: There aren't eight bowls; there are six cups.

line.hanzi: 我喜欢大，不喜欢小。这个大，那个小。
line.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dà, bù xǐhuan xiǎo. Zhè ge dà, nà ge xiǎo.
line.en: I like big, not small. This one's big, that one small.

line.hanzi: 我想做，我会做。这个有多少个？
line.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò, wǒ huì zuò. Zhè ge yǒu duōshao ge?
line.en: I want to do it, I can do it. How many are in this one?

line.hanzi: 这个大，有五个。那个太小，几个？
line.pinyin: Zhè ge dà, yǒu wǔ ge. Nà ge tài xiǎo, jǐ ge?
line.en: This one is big — five of them. That one is too small — how many?

line.hanzi: 这个很大，有九个。那个没有。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge hěn dà, yǒu jiǔ ge. Nà ge méiyǒu.
line.en: This one is very big — nine of them. That one, none.

line.hanzi: 你能吃米饭，不能吃菜。
line.pinyin: Nǐ néng chī mǐfàn, bù néng chī cài.
line.en: You can eat the rice, not the dish.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.hanzi: 这个多，那个少。我喜欢多，不喜欢少。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge duō, nà ge shǎo. Wǒ xǐhuan duō, bù xǐhuan shǎo.
line.en: This one is a lot, that one a little. I like a lot, not a little.

line.hanzi: 这个有十本，那个有三个。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge yǒu shí běn, nà ge yǒu sān ge.
line.en: Ten volumes here, three items there.

line.hanzi: 这个很大，那个太小。这本书，你读？
line.pinyin: Zhè ge hěn dà, nà ge tài xiǎo. Zhè běn shū, nǐ dú?
line.en: This one's very big, that one too small. This book — will you read it?

line.hanzi: 七本，你能读？有九本书。你读多少本？
line.pinyin: Qī běn, nǐ néng dú? Yǒu jiǔ běn shū. Nǐ dú duōshao běn?
line.en: Seven volumes — can you read them? There are nine books. How many will you read?

line.hanzi: 你想读多少本？我会读十本。
line.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng dú duōshao běn? Wǒ huì dú shí běn.
line.en: How many volumes do you want to read? I can read ten.

replies.en: I want to read ten volumes.
I want to read seven volumes.

line.hanzi: 这个大，那个小。大东西，上。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge dà, nà ge xiǎo. Dà dōngxi, shàng.
line.en: This big, that small. Big goods up.

line.hanzi: 里有十本书，下有九本。里有多少本？
line.pinyin: Lǐ yǒu shí běn shū, xià yǒu jiǔ běn. Lǐ yǒu duōshao běn?
line.en: Ten books inside, nine below. How many inside?

line.hanzi: 东西多，你看。书少，我看见五本。
line.pinyin: Dōngxi duō, nǐ kàn. Shū shǎo, wǒ kànjiàn wǔ běn.
line.en: Plenty of goods — take a look. Few books; I see five.

line.hanzi: 里有十本书。你看见多少本？
line.pinyin: Lǐ yǒu shí běn shū. Nǐ kànjiàn duōshao běn?
line.en: Ten books inside. How many do you see?

line.hanzi: 书多，东西少。十本书，在哪儿？
line.pinyin: Shū duō, dōngxi shǎo. Shí běn shū, zài nǎr?
line.en: Lots of books, few parcels. Ten books — where are they?

line.hanzi: 我看这个。这个在前面，东西在{place}。
line.pinyin: Wǒ kàn zhè ge. Zhè ge zài qiánmiàn, dōngxi zài {place}.
line.en: Let me look at this one. This one is in front; the parcel is {place}.

line.hanzi: 东西在前面。我看见东西，你去。
line.pinyin: Dōngxi zài qiánmiàn. Wǒ kànjiàn dōngxi, nǐ qù.
line.en: The parcel is in front. I can see it — you go.

line.hanzi: 你去火车站。我在这读书。
line.pinyin: Nǐ qù huǒchēzhàn. Wǒ zài zhè dú shū.
line.en: You go to the train station. I will read here.

replies.en: I'll go to the train station.

line.hanzi: 名字在上，东西在下。家在哪儿？
line.pinyin: Míngzi zài shàng, dōngxi zài xià. Jiā zài nǎr?
line.en: Name on top, parcel below. Where is the house?

line.hanzi: 先生叫我去这个家里。
line.pinyin: Xiānsheng jiào wǒ qù zhè ge jiā lǐ.
line.en: The gentleman told me to go inside this house.

line.hanzi: 小姐在前面，先生在后面。我看见她。
line.pinyin: Xiǎojiě zài qiánmiàn, xiānsheng zài hòumiàn. Wǒ kànjiàn tā.
line.en: The young woman is in front, the gentleman behind. I see her.

hint.en: The young woman is in front.

line.hanzi: 他在火车站。你看，先生回家。
line.pinyin: Tā zài huǒchēzhàn. Nǐ kàn, xiānsheng huí jiā.
line.en: He's at the station. Look — the gentleman is going home.

replies.en: The young woman is going home.

hint.en: He is at the train station.

line.hanzi: 现在三点。先生在火车站。
line.pinyin: Xiànzài sān diǎn. Xiānsheng zài huǒchēzhàn.
line.en: It's three o'clock. The gentleman is at the train station.

line.hanzi: 上午她去，中午他回。名字在这。
line.pinyin: Shàngwǔ tā qù, zhōngwǔ tā huí. Míngzi zài zhè.
line.en: She goes in the morning, he returns at noon. The name is here.

line.hanzi: 前面五分钟，后面十分钟。你去哪儿？
line.pinyin: Qiánmiàn wǔ fēnzhōng, hòumiàn shí fēnzhōng. Nǐ qù nǎr?
line.en: Front route five minutes, back route ten. Which way?

replies.en: This afternoon I'll take the front route.

line.hanzi: 那时候，小姐叫我回家。
line.pinyin: Nà shíhou, xiǎojiě jiào wǒ huí jiā.
line.en: At that time the young woman told me to go home.

line.hanzi: 出租车在前面，飞机在后面。
line.pinyin: Chūzūchē zài qiánmiàn, fēijī zài hòumiàn.
line.en: The taxi card is in front, the airplane card behind.

line.hanzi: 上午先生来北京，中午小姐回家。
line.pinyin: Shàngwǔ xiānsheng lái Běijīng, zhōngwǔ xiǎojiě huí jiā.
line.en: Morning: the gentleman comes to Beijing. Noon: she goes home.

line.hanzi: 下午，他开出租车。五分钟，她坐飞机。
line.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, tā kāi chūzūchē. Wǔ fēnzhōng, tā zuò fēijī.
line.en: In the afternoon he drives the taxi. In five minutes she takes the plane.

line.hanzi: 名字在上。对不起，先生叫我回。
line.pinyin: Míngzi zài shàng. Duìbuqǐ, xiānsheng jiào wǒ huí.
line.en: The name is on top. Sorry — the gentleman told me to go back.

line.hanzi: 现在下午三点。苹果多少个？
line.pinyin: Xiànzài xiàwǔ sān diǎn. Píngguǒ duōshao ge?
line.en: It is three in the afternoon. How many apples?

replies.en: I see four pieces of fruit.

line.hanzi: 我坐出租车来。钱在这。你买水果？
line.pinyin: Wǒ zuò chūzūchē lái. Qián zài zhè. Nǐ mǎi shuǐguǒ?
line.en: I came by taxi. The money goes here. Are you buying fruit?

line.hanzi: 对不起，商店在前面。苹果三块钱。
line.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, shāngdiàn zài qiánmiàn. Píngguǒ sān kuài qián.
line.en: Sorry — the shop is ahead. The apples are three yuan.

line.hanzi: 这时候水果少。你买些苹果？
line.pinyin: Zhè shíhou shuǐguǒ shǎo. Nǐ mǎi xiē píngguǒ?
line.en: Fruit is scarce at this hour. Will you buy some apples?

line.hanzi: 上午我开出租车，中午我买水果。
line.pinyin: Shàngwǔ wǒ kāi chūzūchē, zhōngwǔ wǒ mǎi shuǐguǒ.
line.en: In the morning I drive the taxi; at noon I buy fruit.

replies.en: In the morning you buy fruit.

line.hanzi: 这个月二十块钱，不是一个星期。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè èrshí kuài qián, bú shì yí ge xīngqī.
line.en: This month is twenty yuan — not one week.

line.hanzi: 一年十二个月。现在十八日。
line.pinyin: Yì nián shí'èr ge yuè. Xiànzài shíbā rì.
line.en: A year has twelve months. It is the eighteenth now.

line.hanzi: 你住这个家，这是你的。我开这个。
line.pinyin: Nǐ zhù zhè ge jiā, zhè shì nǐ de. Wǒ kāi zhè ge.
line.en: You live in this home; this one is yours. I will open this one.

replies.en: The gentleman lives in this home.

line.hanzi: 今天这个时候我来。二十块钱。
line.pinyin: Jīntiān zhè ge shíhou wǒ lái. Èrshí kuài qián.
line.en: I come at this hour today. Twenty yuan.

line.hanzi: 我坐飞机去北京，坐出租车回家。
line.pinyin: Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng, zuò chūzūchē huí jiā.
line.en: I fly to Beijing and come home by taxi.

replies.en: You take a taxi to Beijing.

line.hanzi: 对不起。你买些水果，我买苹果。
line.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ. Nǐ mǎi xiē shuǐguǒ, wǒ mǎi píngguǒ.
line.en: Sorry. You buy some fruit; I will buy the apples.

hint.en: At the shop: buy some fruit.

line.hanzi: 喂，我打电话。你在家？这是我的。
line.pinyin: Wèi, wǒ dǎ diànhuà. Nǐ zài jiā? Zhè shì wǒ de.
line.en: Hello, it's me calling. Are you home? This one's mine.

line.hanzi: 明天你买些苹果吗？水果三块钱。
line.pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ mǎi xiē píngguǒ ma? Shuǐguǒ sān kuài qián.
line.en: Will you buy some apples tomorrow? Fruit is three yuan.

line.hanzi: 今天很冷。你呢？
line.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng. Nǐ ne?
line.en: It's cold today. And you?

line.hanzi: 明天下雨。你住一年吗？今天十八日。
line.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàyǔ. Nǐ zhù yì nián ma? Jīntiān shíbā rì.
line.en: It'll rain tomorrow. Will you stay a year? Today's the eighteenth.

line.hanzi: 这个星期我在家，下个月我不在。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī wǒ zài jiā, xià ge yuè wǒ bú zài.
line.en: This week I am home; next month I am away.

replies.pinyin: Nǐ zhè ge xīngqī zài jiā.
Nǐ zhè ge yuè zài jiā.

line.hanzi: 我爸爸住北京，我妈妈住家里。
line.pinyin: Wǒ bàba zhù Běijīng, wǒ māma zhù jiā lǐ.
line.en: My father lives in Beijing, my mother at home.

line.hanzi: 我儿子住北京，我女儿住家里。
line.pinyin: Wǒ érzi zhù Běijīng, wǒ nǚ'ér zhù jiā lǐ.
line.en: My son lives in Beijing, my daughter at home.

line.hanzi: 我爱我的女儿。她是我的朋友。
line.pinyin: Wǒ ài wǒ de nǚ'ér. Tā shì wǒ de péngyou.
line.en: I love my daughter. She is my friend.

line.hanzi: 我和朋友在家。爸爸打电话：妈妈呢？
line.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou zài jiā. Bàba dǎ diànhuà: māma ne?
line.en: My friend and I are home. Father is calling: where's Mother?

line.hanzi: 明天下雨吗？今天很冷。
line.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàyǔ ma? Jīntiān hěn lěng.
line.en: Will it rain tomorrow? It is cold today.

line.hanzi: 我女儿十八日来，住一个星期。
line.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér shíbā rì lái, zhù yí ge xīngqī.
line.en: My daughter comes on the eighteenth and stays one week.

hint.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqī, bú shì yì nián.

line.hanzi: 我的同学是老师，她在前面。
line.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué shì lǎoshī, tā zài qiánmiàn.
line.en: My classmate is a teacher; she is up front.

line.hanzi: 他是医生，她是学生。今天冷吗？
line.pinyin: Tā shì yīshēng, tā shì xuésheng. Jīntiān lěng ma?
line.en: He's a doctor, she's a student. Is it cold today?

line.hanzi: 我认识这个人，她是我爸爸的朋友。
line.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi zhè ge rén, tā shì wǒ bàba de péngyou.
line.en: I know this person; she is my father's friend.

line.hanzi: 儿子和女儿在家。我很高兴。你呢？
line.pinyin: Érzi hé nǚ'ér zài jiā. Wǒ hěn gāoxìng. Nǐ ne?
line.en: My son and daughter are home. I am glad. And you?

line.hanzi: 喂，我妈妈打电话。
line.pinyin: Wèi, wǒ māma dǎ diànhuà.
line.en: Hello — my mother is calling.

line.hanzi: 明天下雨，我和儿子在家。
line.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒ hé érzi zài jiā.
line.en: It will rain tomorrow; my son and I will be home.

line.hanzi: 谁是老师？他是什么？他是我的朋友。
line.pinyin: Shéi shì lǎoshī? Tā shì shénme? Tā shì wǒ de péngyou.
line.en: Who is the teacher? What is he? He is my friend.

line.hanzi: 老师说话，你听。爸爸和妈妈说话。
line.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuōhuà, nǐ tīng. Bàba hé māma shuōhuà.
line.en: The teacher speaks; you listen. Dad and Mom are talking.

replies.en: I listen to the teacher speak.
I listen to the son speak.

line.hanzi: 我们认识这个人，她是老师。
line.pinyin: Wǒmen rènshi zhè ge rén, tā shì lǎoshī.
line.en: We know this person; she is a teacher.

line.hanzi: 谢谢你。我们听老师说话。我很高兴。
line.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ. Wǒmen tīng lǎoshī shuōhuà. Wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
line.en: Thank you. We listen to the teacher. I'm very happy.

line.hanzi: 我爱我的女儿和儿子。
line.pinyin: Wǒ ài wǒ de nǚ'ér hé érzi.
line.en: I love my daughter and my son.

line.hanzi: 老师和医生说话，你听。
line.pinyin: Lǎoshī hé yīshēng shuōhuà, nǐ tīng.
line.en: The teacher and the doctor are speaking; you listen.

replies.en: I listen to the doctor speak.
I listen to my classmate speak.

line.hanzi: 你学习汉语，我是老师。我们很高兴。
line.pinyin: Nǐ xuéxí Hànyǔ, wǒ shì lǎoshī. Wǒmen hěn gāoxìng.
line.en: You study Chinese; I am the teacher. We are glad.

line.hanzi: 我写字，你看。你写字？这个字是什么？
line.pinyin: Wǒ xiě zì, nǐ kàn. Nǐ xiě zì? Zhè ge zì shì shénme?
line.en: I write a character; look. Will you write one? What is this character?

line.hanzi: 学校有电脑。这个人是医生，谁看？
line.pinyin: Xuéxiào yǒu diànnǎo. Zhè ge rén shì yīshēng, shéi kàn?
line.en: The school has a computer. This person is a doctor — who is looking?

replies.en: The doctor looks at the computer.
The student looks at the computer.

hint.en: The doctor looks at the computer.

line.hanzi: 电视在下，电脑在上。
line.pinyin: Diànshì zài xià, diànnǎo zài shàng.
line.en: The television is below, the computer above.

line.hanzi: 同学说话，你听。
line.pinyin: Tóngxué shuōhuà, nǐ tīng.
line.en: Your classmate is speaking; you listen.

replies.en: I listen to my classmate speak.

line.hanzi: 谢谢你，我们认识，很高兴。
line.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, wǒmen rènshi, hěn gāoxìng.
line.en: Thank you — we have met, and I am glad.

line.hanzi: 桌子在前面，椅子在后面。
line.pinyin: Zhuōzi zài qiánmiàn, yǐzi zài hòumiàn.
line.en: The table goes in front, the chair behind.

line.hanzi: 这是谁的衣服？衣服很漂亮。
line.pinyin: Zhè shì shéi de yīfu? Yīfu hěn piàoliang.
line.en: Whose clothes are these? They are lovely.

line.hanzi: 我们看电影，十点睡觉。
line.pinyin: Wǒmen kàn diànyǐng, shí diǎn shuìjiào.
line.en: We watch a film and sleep at ten.

line.hanzi: 昨天你在学校看什么？写字吗？
line.pinyin: Zuótiān nǐ zài xuéxiào kàn shénme? Xiě zì ma?
line.en: What did you look at at school yesterday? Writing characters?

replies.en: I looked at a computer yesterday.
I look at a computer today.

line.hanzi: 我说话，你听。你学习汉语。
line.pinyin: Wǒ shuōhuà, nǐ tīng. Nǐ xuéxí Hànyǔ.
line.en: I speak; you listen. You are learning Chinese.

line.hanzi: 谢谢你，家很漂亮。
line.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, jiā hěn piàoliang.
line.en: Thank you — the home looks lovely.

line.hanzi: 这几天天气好，上午下雨。
line.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiānqì hǎo, shàngwǔ xiàyǔ.
line.en: The weather has been good these days; it rains in the morning.

hint.en: It isn't cold. It rains in the morning.

line.hanzi: 天热了，请喝水。
line.pinyin: Tiān rè le, qǐng hē shuǐ.
line.en: It has turned hot — please drink some water.

line.hanzi: 对不起，没有水了。
line.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, méiyǒu shuǐ le.
line.en: Sorry, the water is gone.

hint.en: There is no water; it doesn't matter.

line.hanzi: 今天天气很热。
line.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn rè.
line.en: The weather is very hot today.

line.hanzi: 昨天我在学校学习汉语，写字。
line.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài xuéxiào xuéxí Hànyǔ, xiě zì.
line.en: Yesterday I studied Chinese at school and wrote characters.

replies.en: You looked at a computer yesterday.

line.hanzi: 我看电视和电影，十点睡觉。
line.pinyin: Wǒ kàn diànshì hé diànyǐng, shí diǎn shuìjiào.
line.en: I watch television and films, and sleep at ten.

line.hanzi: 医院怎么去？医院在前面。
line.pinyin: Yīyuàn zěnme qù? Yīyuàn zài qiánmiàn.
line.en: How do you get to the hospital? It is ahead.

line.hanzi: 医生四十岁。东西去医院，怎么样？
line.pinyin: Yīshēng sìshí suì. Dōngxi qù yīyuàn, zěnmeyàng?
line.en: The doctor is forty. The parcel goes to the hospital — all right?

hint.en: The parcel goes to the hospital.

line.hanzi: 昨天我看电影，睡觉了。谢谢你。
line.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ kàn diànyǐng, shuìjiào le. Xièxie nǐ.
line.en: Yesterday I watched a film and went to sleep. Thank you.

line.hanzi: 医院怎么去？这几天天气热，没关系。
line.pinyin: Yīyuàn zěnme qù? Zhè jǐ tiān tiānqì rè, méi guānxi.
line.en: How do you get to the hospital? It's been hot lately — never mind.

line.hanzi: 医院里有桌子、椅子。
line.pinyin: Yīyuàn lǐ yǒu zhuōzi, yǐzi.
line.en: Inside the hospital there are tables and chairs.

replies.en: The table is inside the hospital.
The table is inside the shop.

line.hanzi: 这个字是狗，那个字是猫。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge zì shì gǒu, nà ge zì shì māo.
line.en: This character is "dog", that one is "cat".

line.hanzi: 中国的字，我都认识。这个字，怎么读？
line.pinyin: Zhōngguó de zì, wǒ dōu rènshi. Zhè ge zì, zěnme dú?
line.en: Chinese characters — I know them all. This character — how do you read it?

line.hanzi: 医生四十岁，他去这个饭店。怎么样？
line.pinyin: Yīshēng sìshí suì, tā qù zhè ge fàndiàn. Zěnmeyàng?
line.en: The doctor is forty, and he goes to this restaurant. How about it?

line.hanzi: 狗、猫，你都认识？再见。
line.pinyin: Gǒu, māo, nǐ dōu rènshi? Zàijiàn.
line.en: "Dog" and "cat" — do you know both? Goodbye.

replies.en: I recognize both dog and cat.
I don't recognize dog or cat.

line.hanzi: 这几天天气热了，没关系。
line.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiānqì rè le, méi guānxi.
line.en: It has turned hot these days — never mind.

line.hanzi: 这个{size}东西去饭店，那个去医院。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge {size} dōngxi qù fàndiàn, nà ge qù yīyuàn.
line.en: This {size} parcel goes to the restaurant, that one to the hospital.

replies.en: The {size} one goes to the restaurant.
The {size} one goes to the hospital.

line.hanzi: 医院有{count}个医生。多少个？
line.pinyin: Yīyuàn yǒu {count} ge yīshēng. Duōshao ge?
line.en: The hospital has {count} doctors. How many?

line.hanzi: 狗在{place}。你看见了吗？再见。
line.pinyin: Gǒu zài {place}. Nǐ kànjiàn le ma? Zàijiàn.
line.en: The dog label is {place}. Did you see it? Goodbye.

line.hanzi: 医院的在前面。饭店的呢？怎么样？
line.pinyin: Yīyuàn de zài qiánmiàn. Fàndiàn de ne? Zěnmeyàng?
line.en: The hospital's is in front. And the restaurant's? How about it?

line.hanzi: 这个怎么做？中国的东西都去饭店。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge zěnme zuò? Zhōngguó de dōngxi dōu qù fàndiàn.
line.en: How is this done? The Chinese goods all go to the restaurant.

replies.en: The Chinese ones all go to the restaurant.
The Chinese ones all go to the hospital.

line.hanzi: 有{drink}，你喝吗？中国茶好喝。
line.pinyin: Yǒu {drink}, nǐ hē ma? Zhōngguó chá hǎohē.
line.en: We have {drink} — want some? Chinese tea is tasty.

line.hanzi: 这个{container}有狗，那个有猫。都在这。
line.pinyin: Zhè ge {container} yǒu gǒu, nà ge yǒu māo. Dōu zài zhè.
line.en: This {container} has the dog label, that one the cat. Both are here.

line.hanzi: 请做{count}个；饭店的杯子、碗都在这。
line.pinyin: Qǐng zuò {count} ge; fàndiàn de bēizi, wǎn dōu zài zhè.
line.en: Please do {count}; the restaurant's cups and bowls are all here.

line.hanzi: 杯子里{negative}茶。
line.pinyin: Bēizi lǐ {negative} chá.
line.en: In the cup: {negative} tea.

line.hanzi: 好。
line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.pinyin: Hǎo.
line.en: Okay.

line.en: Okay.
